metadata.title: α-Synuclein PFF mouse cortex GeoMx
metadata.description: Segments were captured from specific cortical layers of wildtype mice injected with α-synuclein PFFs in the dorsal striatum, capturing whole transcriptomes from neurons positive for α-synuclein inclusions, or negative for α-synuclein inclusions using the GeoMx WTA platform.
